about: Country cards for lives born in Malaysia. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Malaysia (MY) ===================== PTPTN: study loans charge a 1% yearly ujrah (fee) and are repaid by salary deduction (ptptn.gov.my, as summarised by malaysia4u.com and CTOS, 2026). Malaysian inflation has run at about 2% (DOSM), so in today's money about −1% a year. Many borrowers park spare loan money in ASB/ASM, which paid 4.75–5.75% (PNB): about 2.5% after inflation, an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: sloanR = -.01; sloanN = 15; sloan += .3 * B; mkLot('ptinv', { rate: .025 }, 'trk.ptinv'); addLot('ptinv', .3 * B)

en..x: PTPTN, the national higher-education fund, offers you a loan for your fees and living costs. It charges a 1% yearly fee (ujrah) and is repaid from your salary after you graduate.
en..take.s: Your study costs go on PTPTN at 1% a year, repaid over 15 years.
en..park: Borrow the full amount and save the extra
en..park.s: Borrow {a} more than you need and put it in a PNB fixed-price fund.
en..park.h: The fund’s yearly payout has been well above the loan’s 1% fee.
en..skip.s: Pay with savings and an ordinary loan at the usual interest.

zh..x: 国家高等教育基金（PTPTN）愿意贷款给你付学费和生活费。每年收1%的管理费（ujrah），毕业后从薪水里扣还。
zh..take.s: 学费转成PTPTN贷款，年费1%，分15年还。
zh..park: 借足额度，把多的存起来
zh..park.s: 多借{a}，放进PNB固定价格基金。
zh..park.h: 这类基金每年的派息一直远高于贷款的1%年费。
zh..skip.s: 用存款和一般利率的贷款来付。

zht..x: 國家高等教育基金（PTPTN）願意貸款給你付學費和生活費。每年收1%的管理費（ujrah），畢業後從薪水裡扣還。
zht..take.s: 學費轉成PTPTN貸款，年費1%，分15年還。
zht..park: 借足額度，把多的存起來
zht..park.s: 多借{a}，放進PNB固定價格基金。
zht..park.h: 這類基金每年的派息一直遠高於貸款的1%年費。
zht..skip.s: 用存款和一般利率的貸款來付。

events.src: EPF Akaun Fleksibel: since 11 May 2024, 10% of new contributions go to Account 3, withdrawable at any time (min RM50) (EPF via Malay Mail, 25 Apr 2024). EPF paid 6.30% for 2024 (EPF, 1 Mar 2025, via The Star and Malay Mail).

out.do: const l = lots.epf, y = Math.min(x, l.v); l.v -= y; l.tout += y; return y

opts.do: const y = out(); happy += 3; const t = T('my_epf3', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.my_epf3') }); t.spent += y; t.g += y

en..x: Since May 2024, a tenth of every EPF contribution goes into Akaun Fleksibel, which you can take out at any time. About {a} has built up there. EPF paid a 6.3% dividend for 2024.
en..keep.s: It keeps earning EPF dividends until you retire.
en..spend: Take it out for a holiday and a new phone
en..cash: Take it out as a safety net

zh..x: 从2024年5月起，每笔公积金（EPF）供款有十分之一存进灵活户头（Akaun Fleksibel），随时可以提出。里面已经有约{a}。公积金2024年派息6.3%。
zh..keep.s: 继续领公积金股息，直到退休。

zht..x: 從2024年5月起，每筆公積金（EPF）供款有十分之一存進靈活戶頭（Akaun Fleksibel），隨時可以提出。裡面已經有約{a}。公積金2024年派息6.3%。
zht..keep.s: 繼續領公積金股息，直到退休。

events.src: PNB fixed-price funds: ASM 2 Wawasan paid 4.75 sen a unit (4.75%) for FY2024, beating 12-month fixed deposits by 2.04 points (PNB press release, 30 Aug 2024). After about 2% inflation, roughly 2.5% a year: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: PNB’s fixed-price funds sell units at RM1 that never change price and pay a yearly distribution: ASM 2 Wawasan, open to all Malaysians, paid 4.75% for 2024. You have {a} you won’t need for years.
en..asm.s: Move {a} in. About 2.5% a year after inflation if payouts stay near recent levels; the price never falls.
en..index.s: Move {a} in. About 5% a year after inflation on average, with crashes along the way.

zh..x: PNB的固定价格基金每单位卖RM1，价格不变，每年派息：开放给所有马来西亚人的ASM 2 Wawasan，2024年派息4.75%。你有{a}好几年都用不到。
zh..asm.s: 放入{a}。若派息维持近年水平，扣除通胀后每年约2.5%；价格不会跌。
zh..index.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀后平均每年约5%，中途会遇到股灾。

zht..x: PNB的固定價格基金每單位賣RM1，價格不變，每年派息：開放給所有馬來西亞人的ASM 2 Wawasan，2024年派息4.75%。你有{a}好幾年都用不到。
zht..asm.s: 放入{a}。若派息維持近年水準，扣除通膨後每年約2.5%；價格不會跌。
zht..index.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨後平均每年約5%，中途會遇到股災。

events.src: Open houses (rumah terbuka) at Hari Raya, Chinese New Year, Deepavali and Christmas, with duit raya / ang pao for children: a long-standing Malaysian custom (Tourism Malaysia). The costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: It’s festival season (Hari Raya, Chinese New Year, Deepavali or Christmas) and your turn to hold an open house, where friends, neighbours and colleagues of every background drop in to eat. There is duit raya or ang pao for the children too.
en..big: A big open house with catering
en..big.s: Food for a crowd: about {a}. Happiness +2.
en..visit: Visit other people’s open houses instead

zh..x: 佳节到了（开斋节、农历新年、屠妖节或圣诞节），轮到你办开放门户，各族的朋友、邻居和同事都会来吃东西。还要给孩子们派青包或红包。
zh..big: 办个大型开放门户，请人到会
zh..big.s: 招待一大群人：约{a}。幸福感 +2。
zh..small: 自己煮几道菜请好朋友

zht..x: 佳節到了（開齋節、農曆新年、屠妖節或聖誕節），輪到你辦開放門戶，各族的朋友、鄰居和同事都會來吃東西。還要給孩子們派青包或紅包。
zht..big: 辦個大型開放門戶，請人到會
zht..big.s: 招待一大群人：約{a}。幸福感 +2。
zht..small: 自己煮幾道菜請好朋友

events.src: Monsoon floods: the northeast monsoon (November to March) brings floods in many years (MetMalaysia). After the December 2021 floods, NADMA paid RM1,000 per flood-hit household as Bantuan Wang Ihsan (Malay Mail, 22 Dec 2021): RM1,000 ÷ the game's typical wage (RM21,000 a year) = 0.048. Premiums for a "special perils" flood add-on are an ESTIMATE. The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Your area floods in many northeast-monsoon seasons (November to March). Insurers sell a “special perils” add-on that covers flood damage. After the December 2021 floods, the government paid each flood-hit household RM1,000.

zh..x: 你住的地方在东北季候风季节（11月到3月）常常淹水。保险公司有“特别风险”附加保障，可赔水灾损失。2021年12月水灾后，政府给每户受灾家庭RM1,000。

zht..x: 你住的地方在東北季候風季節（11月到3月）常常淹水。保險公司有「特別風險」附加保障，可賠水災損失。2021年12月水災後，政府給每戶受災家庭RM1,000。

events.src: Working in Singapore from Johor: 250,000–300,000 Malaysians commute daily, some for three hours (Malay Mail 2023; SCMP 2023). Pay in Singapore dollars: about 1.7× (game estimate from the two countries' typical wages); tolls and fuel are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: contract('my_jb', { m: 1.7, cm: 1, yrs: 8, fee: .02 * B }); rec('my_jb', .06 * B, 8, -.8); happy -= 1

en..x: About 250,000–300,000 Malaysians cross into Singapore for work every day, some spending three hours or more on the road. A Singapore company offers you {a} a year while you keep living in Johor.
en..go.s: Paid in Singapore dollars: about {a} a year (you earn {b} now). Tolls and fuel: about {c} a year. Long days on the road: Happiness −4.
en..go.h: The commute costs Health every year.
en..stay.s: Your days stay as they are.

zh..x: 每天约有25万到30万马来西亚人进新加坡上班，有人单是路上就要花三小时以上。一家新加坡公司给你年薪{a}，你可以继续住在柔佛。
zh..go.s: 领新币：年薪约{a}（你现在是{b}）。过路费和油钱每年约{c}。整天在路上：幸福感 −4。
zh..go.h: 通勤每年都会消耗健康。

zht..x: 每天約有25萬到30萬馬來西亞人進新加坡上班，有人單是路上就要花三小時以上。一家新加坡公司給你年薪{a}，你可以繼續住在柔佛。
zht..go.s: 領新幣：年薪約{a}（你現在是{b}）。過路費和油錢每年約{c}。整天在路上：幸福感 −4。
zht..go.h: 通勤每年都會消耗健康。

events.src: First home: first-time buyers pay no stamp duty on homes up to RM500,000 until 31 Dec 2027 (P.U.(A) 448/2025, Budget 2026; Bernama, SAYS). Banks lend up to 90% on a first or second home (Bank Negara's loan-to-value limit applies from the third).

opts.ok: liq >= .11 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.11 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .1, fee: .01, r: .03, n: 35, lk: 'trk.flat' })

en..x: First-time buyers pay no stamp duty on homes up to RM500,000 until the end of 2027, and banks lend up to 90% of the price. A starter home near you costs {p}.
en..buy.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 35 years.

zh..x: 首购族买RM500,000以下的房子，到2027年底都免印花税，银行最多贷九成。你附近一间入门房子要{p}。

zht..x: 首購族買RM500,000以下的房子，到2027年底都免印花稅，銀行最多貸九成。你附近一間入門房子要{p}。

events.src: SSPN: the national education savings scheme paid 4.05% for 2024, the highest in a decade (PTPTN via Bernama); up to RM8,000 a year of net savings is tax-deductible (RinggitPlus; extended to YA2027 in Budget 2025, Deloitte). After inflation about 2%; the tax saving (about 5% of what you put in) is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('sspn', { amt: a, until: age + 15, bonus: .05 }, { rate: .02 }, 'trk.sspn')

en..x: SSPN, the national education savings scheme, paid a 4.05% dividend for 2024, and up to RM8,000 a year of net savings can be deducted from your taxable income.
en..save.s: About {a} a year for 15 years. About 2% a year after inflation, plus a small tax saving.

zh..x: 国家教育储蓄计划（SSPN）2024年派息4.05%，每年最多RM8,000的净储蓄可以扣税。
zh..save.s: 每年约{a}，存15年。扣除通胀后每年约2%，还能省一点税。

zht..x: 國家教育儲蓄計畫（SSPN）2024年派息4.05%，每年最多RM8,000的淨儲蓄可以扣稅。
zht..save.s: 每年約{a}，存15年。扣除通膨後每年約2%，還能省一點稅。

events.src: Medical insurance repricing: after premium rises of up to 40–70% in 2024, Bank Negara Malaysia’s interim measures (20 Dec 2024, until end-2026) spread increases over at least three years so that at least 80% of policyholders see less than 10% a year, and pause increases for a year for over-60s on the minimum plan (BNM via CodeBlue and RinggitPlus, Dec 2024). Co-payment plans with a deductible or co-pay are cheaper. Sizes here (+25% for keeping full cover, −10% for a co-payment plan) are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: insured = false; const t = trk.ins; if (t) t.note = M('note.insOff')

en..x: Your medical card premium is going up again, by a third over the next three years. The insurer also offers a cheaper plan where you pay part of each bill.
en..keep.h: About 25% more a year, and more rises are likely later.
en..copay.s: A lower premium; you pay a share of each claim.
en..drop.s: No more premiums; public hospitals if you are ill.
en..drop.h: Big private bills would be yours alone.

zh..x: 你的医疗卡保费又要涨了，三年内涨三分之一。保险公司也有更便宜的共付计划：每张账单你自付一部分。
zh..keep.h: 每年多大约25%，以后很可能还会涨。
zh..copay.s: 保费低一些；每次理赔要自付一部分。
zh..drop.s: 不用再付保费；生病就去公立医院。
zh..drop.h: 大笔私立医院账单就得自己付。

zht..x: 你的醫療卡保費又要漲了，三年內漲三分之一。保險公司也有更便宜的共付方案：每張帳單你自付一部分。
zht..keep.h: 每年多大約25%，以後很可能還會漲。
zht..copay.s: 保費低一些；每次理賠要自付一部分。
zht..drop.s: 不用再付保費；生病就去公立醫院。
zht..drop.h: 大筆私立醫院帳單就得自己付。

events.src: Medical insurance premiums also rise by age band, which BNM’s 2024 measures do not cap (BNM, Dec 2024). The size here is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: insured = false; const t = trk.ins; if (t) t.note = M('note.insOff')

en..x: You have moved into an older age band, and your medical card premium jumps again.

zh..x: 你进入了较高的年龄级距，医疗卡保费又跳了一级。

zht..x: 你進入了較高的年齡級距，醫療卡保費又跳了一級。

events.src: i-Saraan: EPF’s scheme for the self-employed; from 1 Jan 2025 the government adds 20% of what you pay in, up to RM500 a year and RM5,000 in a lifetime, so RM2,500 a year earns the full RM500 (EPF; Budget 2025; extended into 2026). RM2,500 ≈ 0.12 and RM1,000 ≈ 0.05 of the game’s typical wage. EPF savings are locked until 55.

en..x: Working for yourself, nobody pays into your EPF. Under i-Saraan the government adds 20% to whatever you put in, up to RM500 a year.
en..full.h: The full RM500 top-up every year, and EPF’s dividend on top.
en..none.s: Keep the money for the business.

zh..x: 自雇的话没人帮你缴公积金。在i-Saraan计划下，你存多少，政府就加20%，每年最多RM500。
zh..full.h: 每年拿满RM500补贴，还有公积金的股息。

zht..x: 自僱的話沒人幫你繳公積金。在i-Saraan計畫下，你存多少，政府就加20%，每年最多RM500。
zht..full.h: 每年拿滿RM500補貼，還有公積金的股息。

events.src: Hire purchase: Malaysian car loans charge a flat rate on the original amount for the whole term (Hire-Purchase Act 1967), so a 3% flat rate over 9 years costs about 5.5% a year in effective terms. A RM40,000 car ≈ 1.9 of the game’s typical wage; 9 years at 3% flat ≈ RM5,600 a year (0.27), 5 years at 2.5% flat ≈ RM9,000 a year (0.43). Rates are typical bank offers, an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('my_hp', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.my_hp')}); rec('my_hp', .27 * base, 9); happy += 3
T('my_hp', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.my_hp')}); rec('my_hp', .43 * base, 5); happy += 3

en..t: A new car on hire purchase
en..x: Your old car keeps breaking down. A new local car costs about RM40,000, and the dealer offers a loan over five or nine years.
en..nine.s: About {a} a year, the lowest monthly payment.
en..nine.h: A flat rate is charged on the full loan for all nine years: about 5.5% a year in real terms.
en..five.h: Higher payments, but less interest overall.
en..keep.h: Old cars need repairs more often.

zh..x: 旧车老是坏。一辆新的国产车大约RM40,000，经销商可以帮你办五年或九年的分期。
zh..nine.h: 平息是按整笔贷款算九年利息：实际年利率大约5.5%。
zh..five.h: 月供较高，但总利息比较少。

zht..x: 舊車老是壞。一台新的國產車大約RM40,000，經銷商可以幫你辦五年或九年的分期。
zht..nine.h: 平息是按整筆貸款算九年利息：實際年利率大約5.5%。
zht..five.h: 月付較高，但總利息比較少。

events.src: After SPM: the one-year matriculation programme (Ministry of Education) is free with a monthly allowance; STPM (Form Six, 1.5 years) is free in government schools and known as hard; private foundation or A-level courses cost about RM15,000–30,000 (college fee pages, 2025). RM16,000 ≈ 0.76 of the game’s typical wage. Skill effects are a game rule.

en..x: Your SPM results are out. There are three roads to university.
en..matrik.s: One year, free, with a small allowance.
en..stpm.s: A year and a half, free, and famously hard.

zh..x: SPM成绩出来了。上大学有三条路。
zh..matrik.s: 一年，免费，还有一点津贴。
zh..stpm.s: 一年半，免费，出了名的难。

zht..x: SPM成績出來了。上大學有三條路。
zht..matrik.s: 一年，免費，還有一點津貼。
zht..stpm.s: 一年半，免費，出了名的難。

events.src: Twinning degrees: a “2+1” programme (two years at a Malaysian private university, one in the UK or Australia) costs roughly RM100,000–150,000 in all, against RM300,000+ for a full degree abroad (university fee pages and guides, 2025); a public university degree costs far less. RM100,000 ≈ 4.8 of the game’s typical wage. Pay effects are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You have a place at a public university. Your parents could afford a twinning degree, or even a full degree overseas.
en..twin.s: About {a} in all, paid by your parents.
en..twin.h: Pay about 3% higher for life; it comes out of what they would leave you.
en..abroad.s: About {a} in all, paid by your parents.
en..abroad.h: Pay about 5% higher for life, Happiness +4; it comes out of what they would leave you.

zh..x: 你考上了国立大学。爸妈也负担得起双联课程，甚至全程出国念书。
zh..twin.h: 一辈子的工资大约高3%；这笔钱会从他们留给你的遗产里扣。
zh..abroad.h: 一辈子的工资大约高5%，幸福感 +4；这笔钱会从他们留给你的遗产里扣。

zht..x: 你考上了國立大學。爸媽也負擔得起雙聯課程，甚至全程出國念書。
zht..twin.h: 一輩子的薪水大約高3%；這筆錢會從他們留給你的遺產裡扣。
zht..abroad.h: 一輩子的薪水大約高5%，幸福感 +4；這筆錢會從他們留給你的遺產裡扣。

events.src: Weddings: Malay weddings include hantaran (gifts and money from the groom’s side) and a kenduri (feast); totals of RM30,000 or more are often reported, and many couples borrow (news reports and wedding planners, 2023–2025). RM25,000 ≈ 1.2 of the game’s typical wage. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You and your partner are thinking of marrying, and both families have expectations: gifts, a dowry and a feast for hundreds.
en..grand: A big wedding for the whole kampung
en..grand.h: Happiness +3, and the families are delighted.
en..simple: Just the ceremony and a family dinner

zh..x: 你和伴侣在考虑结婚，两边家人都有期待：聘礼、礼金和几百人的喜宴。
zh..grand.h: 幸福感 +3，两家人都很高兴。

zht..x: 你和伴侶在考慮結婚，兩邊家人都有期待：聘禮、禮金和幾百人的喜宴。
zht..grand.h: 幸福感 +3，兩家人都很高興。

events.src: Private Retirement Schemes: contributions earn income tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year (LHDN, YA2024) and are locked until 55 except for allowed withdrawals. RM3,000 ≈ 0.14 of the game’s typical wage. The tax saved (taken as 10% of the contribution) is an ESTIMATE for a middle earner.

en..x: Your accountant points out that paying into a Private Retirement Scheme earns tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.
en..yes.h: The tax saved adds about a tenth; PRS funds charge about 1.5% a year.

zh..x: 会计师提醒你，投资私人退休计划（PRS）每年可以扣税最多RM3,000。
zh..yes.h: 省下的税大约多一成；PRS基金每年收费大约1.5%。

zht..x: 會計師提醒你，投資私人退休計畫（PRS）每年可以扣稅最多RM3,000。
zht..yes.h: 省下的稅大約多一成；PRS基金每年收費大約1.5%。

events.src: PeKa B40: free health screening for lower-income Malaysians aged 40 and over (ProtectHealth, Ministry of Health). Public clinics (Klinik Kesihatan) charge about RM1 to register for citizens (MOH). The chance of finding high blood pressure is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A letter says you qualify for free health screening under PeKa B40.
en..go.s: Free, at a clinic near you.
en..go.h: Problems found early are much easier to treat.
en..skip.h: Without screening, illness is found later.

zh..x: 一封信说你符合PeKa B40免费健康检查的资格。
zh..skip.h: 不检查，疾病就会晚一点发现。

zht..x: 一封信說你符合PeKa B40免費健康檢查的資格。
zht..skip.h: 不檢查，疾病就會晚一點發現。

events.src: Klinik Kesihatan (public clinics) treat chronic conditions for about RM1 a visit for citizens; private GPs charge much more (MOH; private clinic fee schedules). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('my_gp', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.my_gp')}); rec('my_gp', .02 * base, 10); health += 2

en..x: The screening found high blood pressure. You will need tablets and check-ups.

zh..x: 检查发现你有高血压，要吃药、定期复诊。

zht..x: 檢查發現你有高血壓，要吃藥、定期回診。

events.src: E-hailing drivers in Malaysia must be covered by PERKESO’s Self-Employment Social Security Scheme (SKSPS, Act 789); the lowest plan costs RM232.80 a year (PERKESO, 2024), about 0.011 of the game’s typical wage, and pays medical costs and lost income after an accident. Weekend earnings (≈ RM2,000 a year) and accident odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You could drive for an e-hailing app at weekends with your own car.
en..cover.s: About {a} a year, less {b} for the cover.
en..cover.h: Health a little lower each year; accidents are covered.
en..drive.h: Health a little lower each year; an accident would be on you.

zh..x: 你可以周末用自己的车跑网约车。
zh..cover.h: 健康每年少一点；出车祸有保障。
zh..drive.h: 健康每年少一点；出车祸要自己负责。

zht..x: 你可以週末用自己的車跑網約車。
zht..cover.h: 健康每年少一點；出車禍有保障。
zht..drive.h: 健康每年少一點；出車禍要自己負責。

events.src: PERKESO SKSPS pays medical costs and a daily allowance after an accident at work (PERKESO). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A motorbike hits your car while you are carrying a passenger. {x}
en..cov: PERKESO pays your treatment and lost days.
en..nocov: With no cover, treatment and repairs cost you {a}.
en..ok: Give up driving for the app

zh..x: 你载客时被一辆摩托车撞了。{x}
zh..cov: PERKESO付了你的医药费和休息期间的收入。
zh..nocov: 没有保障，医药费和修车费花了你{a}。

zht..x: 你載客時被一台機車撞了。{x}
zht..cov: PERKESO付了你的醫藥費和休息期間的收入。
zht..nocov: 沒有保障，醫藥費和修車費花了你{a}。

events.src: EPF at 55: members can withdraw all their savings from age 55, or leave them in to keep earning the dividend, 6.30% for 2024 (KWSP, Feb 2025), about 3% after inflation. Many withdraw early and run short later (EPF surveys).

opts.do: lots.epf.v = 0; lots.epf.tout += v; cash += v; happy += 2
lots.epf.v -= v / 2; lots.epf.tout += v / 2; cash += v / 2; happy += 1

en..x: You can now take out all of your EPF savings: {a}.
en..all.h: Happiness +2, but it no longer earns EPF’s dividend.
en..keep.s: Take money out when you need it.
en..keep.h: EPF has paid about 3% a year above inflation.

zh..x: 你现在可以把公积金全部领出来了：{a}。
zh..all.h: 幸福感 +2，但就领不到公积金的股息了。
zh..keep.h: 公积金扣除通胀后每年大约3%。

zht..x: 你現在可以把公積金全部領出來了：{a}。
zht..all.h: 幸福感 +2，但就領不到公積金的股息了。
zht..keep.h: 公積金扣除通膨後每年大約3%。
